list: The official 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden), names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are this entry's own words; each cites the sources it draws on. GTA 6 launched 19 Nov 2026, so a detail no guide has pinned down yet is marked unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, then strangers, then activities and collectibles, then 100% completion) and this is the last sound you will hear. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx's roadmap, which puts the platinum at about 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It unlocks through normal story play in Chapter 1 and cannot be missed — just play the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone, which places it among the first missions of Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by finishing its story missions in order. A story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by finishing its story missions in order. A story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by finishing its story missions in order. A story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 by finishing its story missions in order. A story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story — the last mission of Chapter 5. This gold trophy is hidden until earned and cannot be missed: finish the story and it pops. Free roam continues after the credits, so nothing after this point is locked behind it. Sources: the official list on Exophase; PowerPyx, which notes free roam after the story and no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission according to GTA-Zone. It unlocks through normal story play and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission according to GTA-Zone. It unlocks through normal story play and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission according to GTA-Zone. It unlocks through normal story play and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission according to GTA-Zone. It unlocks through normal story play and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission according to GTA-Zone. It unlocks through normal story play and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission according to GTA-Zone. It unlocks through normal story play and cannot be missed. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion, tracked in Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist only becomes viewable after the story, but progress made during the story already counts. It is the hardest trophy and the bulk of the platinum: about 100 of the 200 hours. PowerPyx and KeenGamer report it needs 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, plus the robbery sets (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies) and the collectible targets. Nothing on the checklist is missable. Sources: PowerPyx's roadmap; KeenGamer's trophy guide; GTA-Zone's trophy list.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count — and 100% completion wants 300 of them — so you do not need every stunt, just most of the easy ones. Stunts build up naturally from jumps, near misses and airtime as you drive; check the counter in the Progress menu and mop up the remainder after the story. Sources: GTA-Zone, which reports the 397 total and the 300-for-100% figure; PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — nine activity types in total, according to KeenGamer. Dip into everything the game offers at least once: races, fishing, the arcade, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, hunting, meditation and the rest. It pops when the last untried type is sampled, so keep a mental note of what you have not touched yet. Sources: KeenGamer's trophy guide; the official list on Exophase.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges according to GTA-Zone. Each range runs its own drills with its own gold threshold, so work through them one range at a time and repeat a drill until the gold score lands. This is one of the longer silver trophies — expect to come back to it after the story. Sources: GTA-Zone, which reports the 42 challenges and 12 ranges; KeenGamer.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — one win at each of the 14 spots, according to GTA-Zone. You do not need to win every race at a spot, just one per location; 100% completion wants all 42 races. Learn each course's line, then move on to the next spot. Sources: GTA-Zone; PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer, according to GTA-Zone. Winning the same race twice does not count, so spread your wins across new events and tick them off as you go. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon, according to GTA-Zone — head to the marker when the message arrives and out-fish him in the challenge. Sources: GTA-Zone; KeenGamer's trophy guide.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one arcade cabinet game through to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you enjoy most and finish a full run. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's trophy list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Andy's chain is Lucia-only, according to GTASpotter, so play it as Lucia. Stranger quest givers who go quiet mid-story become available again later — PowerPyx notes every trophy-related quest giver is still there in free roam after the story — so this cannot be missed. Sources: GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table; GTASpotter's trophy guide; PowerPyx's roadmap.

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's jobs as they appear; if he goes unavailable during the story, he comes back — PowerPyx notes every trophy-related quest giver is still there in free roam after the story. Sources: GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table; PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, according to GTA-Zone, and the strand stays open after the story. Sources: GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every stranger strand counts: GTA-Zone reports Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not — so aim at the counting four first, then add four more qualifying strands. Note this is a different count from the five named-character finals, which have their own trophies. Sources: GTA-Zone; KeenGamer's trophy guide.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Work through Randy's jobs as they appear; if he goes unavailable during the story, he comes back in free roam — PowerPyx notes every trophy-related quest giver is still there after the story. Sources: GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table; PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Tyrone's chain is Jason-only, according to GTASpotter, so play it as Jason. If he goes unavailable during the story, he comes back — PowerPyx notes every trophy-related quest giver is still there in free roam after the story. Sources: GTA-Zone's hidden-trophy table; GTASpotter's trophy guide; PowerPyx's roadmap.

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia, according to KeenGamer. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE — the only trophy PowerPyx flags: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the morning at Jason's house. Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept; that meditation raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and it is gone after Chapter 1 — nobody has confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. The last meditation needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Note 100% completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy is separate from A Long Road. Sources: PowerPyx's roadmap (the missable warning); KeenGamer (18 spots); GTA-Zone (the missable note).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting quests start after Chapter 2 and are Jason-only, according to GTA-Zone — but the exact animal is not confirmed yet, so this is one to check against a fresh guide before you go hunting. Play Bret's chain as Jason once it opens and follow his prompts. Sources: GTA-Zone (Jason-only, after Chapter 2, animal unconfirmed); PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets, out of 18 sets in total according to GTA-Zone. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick three sets and hunt their cards down; 100% completion wants 15 sets, so this trophy is only the start of the card hunt. Sources: GTA-Zone; KeenGamer's trophy guide.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — any mix of Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags, according to GTA-Zone. Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan things as you travel; the habit pays twice, since scanning also feeds the vehicle-discovery trophy. Sources: GTA-Zone; KeenGamer's trophy guide.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges — 100% completion wants 70 of them, according to GTA-Zone. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, according to PowerPyx, covering everything from robberies to exploration, so this fills in as you play the rest of the list. Check the Progress menu to see which groups are closest to done. Sources: PowerPyx's roadmap (eight groups of ten); GTA-Zone (50 for the trophy, 70 for 100%).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bring your partner along, build the wanted level up to four stars, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears — a fast car and a quiet corner of the map help. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's trophy list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in one spree with your partner present, keeping the wanted level alive between them — plan a route past three close shops and keep moving. Sources: the official list on Exophase; GTA-Zone's trophy list.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them — 100% completion wants 200 of the 277 base models, according to GTA-Zone. Scan unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel; traffic, parking lots and car meets are all fair game, and the habit also feeds the WAiNK locations trophy. Sources: GTA-Zone; KeenGamer's trophy guide.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus first, then trigger it with an assault rifle against a group of five or more, according to GTA-Zone — gang hideouts and police chases are good places to find a crowd. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport): steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding gate, take off and get about 1 km away, according to GTA-Zone. Expect a wanted level on the runway — get airborne fast and put distance between you and the airport. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos: steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it, according to GTA-Zone. The air station is guarded, so go in ready for a fight, grab the Rhino and use its cannon on the soldiers coming for you. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs give you the Snap Gun for the back door, according to GTA-Zone — take that route in, stay quiet, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. Sources: GTA-Zone; PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape, out of 8 in the game. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, according to GTA-Zone, and always bring 4 stars — have a fast bike ready for the getaway and a planned route out. Sources: GTA-Zone; PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks roam the roads — hit one and get away clean. GTA-Zone notes a bank vault job counts for this one too if you get away, so it may pop while you work on Maximum Withdrawal. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map. GTA-Zone's advice is to fly: a plane covers ground far faster than driving every road. Sweep the map in a grid and watch the fog lift as you go. Sources: GTA-Zone; KeenGamer's trophy guide.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, 9 gangs in total, according to GTA-Zone. All 39 operations are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy is the first third of that job: clear one operation for every gang, then keep going for A Long Road. Sources: GTA-Zone; PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. UNCONFIRMED: GTA-Zone lists the exact trigger as unconfirmed — neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned it down yet. The description points to ordering a cocktail at an Ocean Beach spot with a view, so try the beachfront bars and check a fresh guide before spending long on it. Sources: GTA-Zone (trigger unconfirmed); the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. UNCONFIRMED: GTA-Zone notes the description points to driving out through the showroom window, but no guide has confirmed the exact showroom or trigger yet. Try driving a car out through a dealership's front window and check a fresh guide if it does not pop. Sources: GTA-Zone (unconfirmed); the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn, then lose the police, according to GTA-Zone. This doubles as one of the nine gang operations for Pest Control, so it is worth doing on the way to that trophy. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia, according to GTA-Zone. Working out together trains both, so take them to the gym as a pair and grind the Strength stat to its cap on each of them. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse): 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile, according to GTA-Zone. The counter builds from the choices you make across the game, so it fills in over a full playthrough. One warning from the guides: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile — it is permanent. Sources: GTA-Zone (500 actions, Irredeemable warning); GTASpotter's trophy guide.

sources.name: GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. UNCONFIRMED: GTA-Zone lists the exact trigger as unconfirmed — no guide has pinned down what has to fail once and succeed the second time. Treat this as a watch-and-wait trophy and check a fresh guide as players crack it. Sources: GTA-Zone (trigger unconfirmed); the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? UNCONFIRMED: GTA-Zone lists the exact trigger as unconfirmed — no guide has pinned down the strange event behind this one yet. Treat this as a watch-and-wait trophy and check a fresh guide as players crack it. Sources: GTA-Zone (trigger unconfirmed); the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. UNCONFIRMED: GTA-Zone lists the exact trigger as unconfirmed. The description points to a drive-by with a melee weapon — knocking people over like bowling pins from a moving vehicle — but no guide has confirmed the exact setup yet, so check a fresh guide before grinding it. Sources: GTA-Zone (trigger unconfirmed); the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, not a single haul, and Yasmani pays the most, according to GTA-Zone — so route your Marked Bills through him whenever you can and the counter climbs fastest. Sources: GTA-Zone; PowerPyx's roadmap.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total according to GTA-Zone. Every shop purchase counts, so it fills in on its own over a full playthrough — big purchases like vehicles and properties move it fastest. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the 8 garages for sale, about $160,000 in total, according to GTA-Zone. The 4 story garages do not count — only the ones you buy yourself. Save up, then buy the remaining garages in one sweep. Sources: GTA-Zone; KeenGamer's trophy guide.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses gives you in Chapter 2, according to GTA-Zone. You need free garage space for each registration, so keep slots open and register cars as you collect them. Sources: GTA-Zone; the official list on Exophase.
